moments.selftext: Israeli billionaire Shlomo Kramer is now openly calling for the First Amendment to be eliminated in the United States. He says artificial intelligence will play a major role in restricting free speech. Kramer claims the First Amendment must be limited to “protect it” before it is too late, while calling for total control over all social media platforms.
